content.comment_body: Hello, Could you clarify the distinction between connecting two [product_name] devices within a network project compared to using the 'Tools > Ethernet Connection' option? Thank you.

Within a network project, the option to generate a connection under 'Tools > Ethernet Connection' is unavailable (grayed out). In the network view, you can establish a link between two [product_name] devices by drawing a connecting line or dragging an input in one diagram to an output in another. For network projects, connections to other partners (such as HMI, [version_no], or external devices) are also possible. Example videos are provided.

Hello [user_name], Could you elaborate further on TSAP settings shown in your fourth video? The manual states the TSAP range in the [product_name] Base Module is 20.00 to FF.FF, but in the network project view, the range appears limited to 20.00 to 27.00.

Hi [user_name], I have a slightly different question. How can one establish a connection from the internet to the local LAN for [product_name]8_1, which has a fixed public IP address, as illustrated in your examples? Is the method from your first example recommended, and what can be done when the 'Tools > Ethernet Connection' option is inaccessible?
Hello [user_name], Yes, it is possible. While I haven't personally done it, two users from another forum managed it successfully after working through some initial issues. [url]
When establishing connections in Network view using drag and drop, the TSAP number is automatically assigned by the software. The first TSAP is 20.00, the next is 21.00, and so forth.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to understand the differences between creating device connections using the network project view versus the 'Tools > Ethernet Connection' menu in [product_name] configuration software. There is uncertainty regarding which approach suits different networking setups, particularly for connecting multiple [product_name] devices, and how TSAP values are handled. Some features are inaccessible and documentation about TSAP ranges appears inconsistent with what users experience in practice.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for clear explanations about the practical distinctions and best use cases for each method of connection setup, as well as straightforward guidance about configuring TSAP ranges within the software.
